scope: offline output evidence extension only; pending execution under a new producer binding
legacy_compatibility_test: Historical counts/invalid/gain_gaps/examples compared against preserved producer for unchanged, ETA-change, HOLD, claims and changed-cost cases.
population: Every opportunity with at least two known scored OD candidates under unchanged receiver capacity and ordinary protection filters; unchanged cases included without truncation.
candidate_fields: All scored candidates retain action/tray/source/destination/owner, fractional nominal ETA and transfer duration, proxy gains, costs and common/exact_same_cost/exact_actual_cost net scores.
causal_scope: Only common versus exact_same_cost changes identify ETA-only ranking differences; exact_same_cost versus exact_actual_cost is a separately named cost-model comparison.
change_denominators: Source and destination changes require both bests to be moves. HOLD and tray changes are separate flags; all candidate rows and all three bests remain available.
exclusion_scope: Untimed receiver claims retain original exclusion counters and produce no fabricated score or ranking row. Unknown scored candidates are not imputed as zero.
pure_guards: 35 unchanged full opportunities with zero examples
production_rebinding_required: strong_baseline helper dependencies if they bind final_science SHA
figures dependencies if they bind final_science SHA
